skills.name: skill-creator
skills.title: Skill Creator
skills.description: Anthropic 官方技能创作工具，从零创建、修改、评测一个 skill，或优化 description 以提升触发准确率。
skills.description_en: Anthropic's official tool for creating, modifying, and evaluating skills.
skills.usage: 当要创建新 skill、改进现有 skill，或跑评测 / 优化触发词时使用。
skills.usage_en: Use when creating or improving a skill, or running evals to tune its triggers.
skills.notes: 示例条目，可替换为任意真实第三方 skill。
skills.notes_en: Example entry; replace with any real third-party skill.
